results.title: Nepal and Bangladesh’s relationship with China after youth uprising
results.snippet: China is the second largest trading partner of Nepal. Like in Bangladesh, China is the largest source of foreign investment in Nepal particularly in hydropower, tourism and manufacturing. In 2024-2025, China’s FDI in Nepal was 45.34 percent of the total FDI, according to the Department of Industry. China is one of the largest sources of foreign tourists in Nepal.
